ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
numpy:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
name: batoid
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: batoid
  version: "0.9.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 828984b11a76c24bb4cfbef8aae8930aad50a60af9389de1782d082a1eb1213d

build:
  number: 3
  skip: win
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: pybind11
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - if: not linux
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - pybind11
    - numpy
    - pytest-runner
    - if: not linux
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
  run:
    - python
    - pyyaml
    - scipy
    - galsim
    - matplotlib-base
    - astropy-base

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - batoid
      pip_check: false

about:
  summary: c++ backed python optical raytracer
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/jmeyers314/batoid

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - beckermr
    - jmeyers314
